anomaly_mapping: the source's own bearing codes: ['KA01', 'KA03', 'KI01', 'KI03'] are damaged (KA = outer race, KI = inner race); K001-K005 are undamaged
channel: phase_current_1 — the first channel in the source's own order (force, phase_current_1, phase_current_2, speed, temp_2_bearing_module, torque, vibration_1) that meets the 20480-sample minimum; force has only 16001. Prereg AMENDMENT 6.
license: Paderborn University KAt-DataCenter bearing dataset, free for scientific use with citation of Lessmeier et al. (PHM Europe 2016)
modality: motor phase current on a bearing test rig
subset_rule: fit = ['K001', 'K002', 'K003'], eval normal = ['K004', 'K005'], eval anomaly = ['KA01', 'KA03', 'KI01', 'KI03']; every run of every operating point, sorted by filename; split by bearing code so no bearing appears in both halves; first 20480 samples stored
